instruction: Before any native generation, require PASS for image-execution-admission-v1 bound to this exact execution/task/request and sealed story instruction. Admission must prove story-only generator context, no orchestration context, and one approved exact-byte persistence route; admission failure consumes zero attempts and triggers Strategy Interrupt. Generate from the sealed story specification with the proven professional native-image path; capture exact PNG bytes immediately; persist via an approved small-PNG route; verify read-back identity; review the saved Git asset; accept_locked or reject only this image. On ACCEPTED_LOCKED, persist the deterministic Active-to-Done IMAGE_ACCEPTED_LOCKED transition in the same substantive boundary; do not create a pointer-only wake PR, do not wait for a Watchdog, and do not require an owner liveness prompt. The event-driven Supervisor consumes that transition to dispatch the next image or Task 17.
